title: Guido van Rossum: Python and the Future of Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #341
summary: A roughly three-hour Lex Fridman podcast conversation with Guido van Rossum, the creator of Python. Topics include Python's design, the GIL, asyncio, the future of programming and AI coding tools.
why: HN points to it for Guido's own views on the GIL, Python internals and using Copilot, especially in Python-related threads.

quote.text: I recommend this interview to get a slightly better glimpse of the guy
